minutes.headline: TCP committee will ask the Select Board for more design money, a wider charge, and a second tear-down track.
minutes.summary: The committee aired disagreement over the previous night's committee report to the Select Board, then planned its March 9 Select Board appearance. Members agreed informally to seek more design funding, ask to change the charge to building and/or land, and develop two products, one to preserve and one to build new. One member will draft three warrant articles; January 13 minutes were approved and meeting dates set.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the January 13 meeting
votes.outcome: passed (four ayes heard on roll call)

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said the site package estimate looked possibly high to the DPW director and to him; paving by DPW would still be town money from a different bucket.
Members said the design budget is spent and the architects still owe final documents and a town meeting presentation, so more funding is needed.
The town manager said an appropriation is needed and an estimate from the architect should be pinned down soon so the finance committee can discuss it.

budget_items.topic: Debt scenarios for TCP and Turkey Hill
budget_items.what_was_said: The financial advisor ran 30-year scenarios for both projects; both fit the town's debt ratios, and 20-year versions are coming.
A member recalled the middle high school spent about half a million on feasibility studies before design, as an example of the cost of investigating.

decisions.decision: Remove language from the Select Board letter about the committee's role in the future use of the other vacated buildings.
Informal consensus to ask for added design funding, a charge change to and/or, and two products (preserve and build new).
A member will draft three warrant articles: an update report, a charge change, and funding.
The chair will simplify the letter into bullet points and circulate it for review before sending to the town manager.
Meetings set for March 9 (Select Board), March 17, April 7 and April 21.
Post a joint meeting for March 9 since a quorum may attend the Select Board.

what_happened.line: The TCP Building Design Committee reached informal consensus to ask for added design funding, a wider charge (building and/or land), and two products: preserve or build new.
The committee will remove language about the future use of other vacated buildings from its Select Board letter; the chair will simplify it to bullets for review.
A member will draft three warrant articles: an update report, a charge change, and funding.
Members said the architects' design budget is spent while final documents and a town meeting presentation are still owed.
No formal votes on the asks were taken; the January 13 minutes were approved and meetings were set for March 9, March 17, April 7 and April 21.

why_it_matters: Further design money for the town center building project would need an appropriation, so residents may be asked to vote on funding and a changed committee charge at Town Meeting.

The financial advisor's debt scenarios for this project and Turkey Hill were described as fitting the town's debt ratios, with 20-year versions still to come, so the borrowing cost is not yet settled.
watch_next: March 9 Select Board appearance, where the committee will present its requests; later meetings set for March 17, April 7 and April 21.
The three draft warrant articles, and an architect's estimate for further design that the town manager said should be pinned down soon for the finance committee.
